criteria_source: offline step on the study GPU

family_upper_bound_95.method: one-sided Clopper-Pearson upper bound at 0.05/37 for each policy (successes of its completed episodes), Bonferroni over the 37

selection_regret.label: biased upward: the largest of seven counts on the same 61 episodes

h1.family_rule: p* from the episodes as they came, every episode with a missing side counted as discordant; the tie-STOP sensitivity uses the same family
h1.screen: Tarone's procedure made alpha-consistent (Hommel and Krummenauer 1998): reject H0_j if p_j <= gamma / K(gamma) for some gamma in (0, 0.05]

h1_tie_stop_sensitivity.family_rule: p* from the episodes as they came, every episode with a missing side counted as discordant; the tie-STOP sensitivity uses the same family
h1_tie_stop_sensitivity.screen: Tarone's procedure made alpha-consistent (Hommel and Krummenauer 1998): reject H0_j if p_j <= gamma / K(gamma) for some gamma in (0, 0.05]
